changelog: Phase F (P17-P21): Data size optimization, dedicated avatar streaming, and reliable database backup/restore. Added Express gzip compression middleware and uncompressed X-Payload-Bytes payload monitoring on /api/data with warning threshold. Extracted photo blobs from bulk /api/data payload into lazy-loaded /api/photo endpoint with role-based scoping and ETag caching. Added benchmark load testing CLI tool (npm run load-test) to measure throughput and response sizes against an isolated throwaway database. Implemented production-grade CLI backup (npm run backup) with keyset pagination and restore (npm run restore) with foreign key topological dependency sort and atomic transaction rollback. Added Owner-facing in-app 'Download Full Backup' stream and removed legacy Google Drive backup code.
